list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete four-shell assembly has a statistically disordered central Se(IV) site, an Eu4 tetrahedron, and an enclosing Eu6 octahedron. Four isonicotinic ligands connect the Eu shells; four tri-Se-substituted GeW9 polyoxometalate units cap the remaining octahedral faces, forming an outer supertetrahedral shell. The incorporated Eu10Se13 core contains 23 Eu/Se ions.

synthesis.procedure: An aqueous solution containing SeO2, Eu(ClO4)3, and a trilacunary α-[GeW9O34]10− precursor was left standing for 6 hours at room temperature under normal atmospheric pressure. The main article gives no numerical reagent quantities and refers to the ESI for details.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Standing aqueous solution at normal atmospheric pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colorless crystals formed after the mixture stood for 12 hours.
